done_when: Each cold reader's and reviewer's brief lists earlier rounds' notes with their answers and the findings already fixed or dismissed, and a note or finding that repeats a settled one cannot block or start another round. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body:
A new note can be silently marked as a clean read when the reader repeats a settled note in the same reply.
Raise: Functional — `_findings(said)` stores findings by their supplied number. If a reader writes `1. New delivery defect` followed by `1. Saving needs an account` (a settled note), the second entry replaces the first. Filtering then removes the settled entry and sets `said` to `No findings.`, so the new defect cannot block. The named test covers only uniquely numbered replies.
findings.title: New cold-read notes can be lost when a settled note repeats

why: Readers and reviewers reopen what earlier rounds already settled
